faq.question: Is there a verified Bluehost promo code on this page?
faq.answer: No. We did not find a public code in the official pages reviewed. The prices above are published plan prices, not proof that a separate code will work.

faq.question: How do I get the listed introductory price?
faq.answer: Follow the official plan link, choose the matching product and billing term, then review the full charge and renewal rate before purchasing. We did not test checkout.

faq.question: Does the free domain offer cover every domain?
faq.answer: No. It applies only to the eligible extensions and purchases in the official policy; premium domains are excluded.

faq.question: Is monthly VPS hosting covered by the guarantee?
faq.answer: The official refund policy excludes services with a monthly term. Check the policy and your exact order before relying on a refund.
